definitions.explanation: Connects nouns in a complete list. りんごとみかん (apples and oranges). Unlike や, と implies a complete enumeration.
Indicates doing something together with someone. {友達|ともだち}と{行|い}く (go with a friend).
Marks quoted speech or thoughts. 「はい」と{言|い}う (say 'yes'), いいと{思|おも}う (think it's good).
Expresses a natural or inevitable consequence. {春|はる}になると{暖|あたた}かくなる (when spring comes, it gets warm).
Shows how something appears or is named. {同|おな}じと{思|おも}う (think it's the same).

accompaniment_verbs.example: {彼女|かのじょ}と{結婚|けっこん}する

quotation_verbs.example: {日本語|にほんご}で「{愛|あい}」と{書|か}く

comparison_verbs.example: {去年|きょねん}と{比|くら}べる

particle_contrasts.explanation: と gives a complete list; や gives an incomplete list (examples)

examples.to_example: りんごとみかんを{買|か}った
examples.to_english: bought apples and oranges (only these two)

examples.ya_example: りんごやみかんを{買|か}った
examples.ya_english: bought apples and oranges (and other things)

key_points: と = exhaustive list (A and B, that's all)
や = non-exhaustive list (A and B, etc.)
や often pairs with など: りんごやみかんなど

particle_contrasts.explanation: Both can mark companion, but と implies mutual action, に implies direction toward

examples.ni_note: に: going to where friend is

key_points: Some verbs can take either with slight nuance difference

conditional_usage.description: と as a conditional expresses natural/inevitable consequences
characteristics: Used for general truths and habitual actions
Cannot be used for requests, commands, or intentions

common_mistakes.incorrect: りんごと{買|か}いました (intending 'I bought apples and other things')

common_mistakes.explanation: Use や (not と) for non-exhaustive lists

common_mistakes.incorrect: {終|お}わると{帰|かえ}ってください
common_mistakes.correct: {終|お}わったら{帰|かえ}ってください
common_mistakes.explanation: と conditional cannot be used for requests; use 〜たら

common_mistakes.mistake: Omitting quotation と before {思|おも}う/{言|い}う
common_mistakes.explanation: Quotation と is required before {思|おも}う, {言|い}う, etc.

notes:
と is one of the most versatile particles in Japanese, with five major uses.

FUNCTIONS:
と has five major uses:
- listing — AとB, a complete/exhaustive 'A and B'
- accompaniment — doing something together with someone
- quotation — marks quoted speech or thought before ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧, ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧, etc.
- conditional — a natural or automatic consequence ('whenever/if')
- comparison — the standard in ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ / ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧

LISTING (AとB):
Connects nouns in a complete, exhaustive list. AとB means "A and B (and nothing else)." For incomplete lists, use ⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧ instead.

ACCOMPANIMENT (～と):
Marks the person you do something with. Implies mutual participation. Compare: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧と⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (meet with a friend — mutual) vs. ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (meet a friend — directional).

QUOTATION (～と⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧／⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧):
Marks quoted speech or thought. Required before verbs like ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧, ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧, ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧, ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧. Omitting と before ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ is a common learner mistake.

CONDITIONAL (～と):
Expresses natural or automatic consequences. Cannot be used for requests or commands. Use ～たら for those instead.

COMPARISON (～と⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧／⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧):
Marks the standard of comparison: これと⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ (same as this), ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧と⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ (different from yesterday).
